meta.title: Installation · origam design system
meta.description: Get origam up and running in minutes. Install the npm package, register the plugin, and start building with 95+ accessible Vue 3 components.

hero.subtitle: Install origam, register the plugin, and start building with 95+ accessible, token-driven Vue 3 components right away.

steps.subtitle: From zero to a fully themed Vue 3 app with origam — no boilerplate needed.

install.title: 1. Install
install.description: Add origam to your project with your preferred package manager.

register.title: 2. Register the plugin
register.description: Import the token sheets and register origam as a Vue plugin in your entry file.
register.note: createOrigam() accepts an optional options bag to configure icons, locale, display, SSR, aliases and more. By default, all components and directives are registered globally.

use.title: 3. Use a component
use.description: All components are globally registered. Drop any Origam component into your templates — no per-file import needed.

theming.title: 4. Theming
theming.description: origam ships with light and dark themes. Switch statically via an HTML attribute, or at runtime with the useTheme composable.
theming.sub_static: Static switch — HTML attribute (omit to follow system preference):
theming.note: Import origam/tokens/css/dark once at boot to enable the dark token sheet.

nuxt.title: 5. Nuxt integration
nuxt.description: Using Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4? The official origam Nuxt module is included in the same package — no extra install required.
nuxt.note: The Nuxt module is delivered as a sub-export (origam/nuxt) — no separate package to install. It auto-imports all components and composables, and resolves themes SSR-safely.

peer_deps.title: Peer dependencies.
peer_deps.subtitle: origam has a minimal footprint. Vue 3 is the only mandatory peer — everything else is optional and tree-shaken when unused.
peer_deps.node_note: Node >= 22 is required to build origam from source. Consumers need only Vue 3.5+ at runtime.

cta.title: Ready to build?
cta.description: Explore the full component catalogue, browse interactive stories, or dive into the source on GitHub.
